notes.title: Rotschwert - V1.1 Changelog
notes.content:
Rotschwert V1.1 is now on Steam and it's been almost a day, I hope you've been enjoying your first few visits.

Here is the highlight for some of the noteworthy changes:

[h3]New:[/h3][list][*]Segment Select "AlterEgo" is now available[/*][*]Given a purpose to an obscure, abandoned space[/*][/list][h3]Stage changes:[/h3][list][*]Segment 1 - orbital +drones section redesigned - bigger drones die instantly when the smaller ones are destroyed, releasing a "bonus" wave afterwards[/*][*]Segment 1  - extended the mini-tutorial at the start of Relaxed Reverie to give new players more time to adjust[/*][*]Segment 2 - redesigned most of the later patterns[/*][*]Segment 3 - adjusted reflector enemy spawns to prevent unfair damage[/*][*]Segment 4 - sword-wielding enemies' shields are now breakable, making their sections easier to chain[/*][*]Segment ??? - adjusted patterns and bullet visuals to add more variety and make them more readable[/*][*]????????????? - completely redesigned[/*][/list][h3]General:[/h3][list][*]Adjustments to enemy sprites, as well as acceleration, backgrounds, and particle effect visuals[/*][*]DirectX related updates - this [i]should[/i] fix various graphical glitches with AMD GPUs[/*][*]Performance improvements - framerates should be higher, especially on weaker machines[/*][*]Text, grammar, font and story corrections[/*][*]A bunch of small, meaninglessly meaningful things with meaningfully meaningless conditions[/*][/list]
Take care, and good luck!

notes.title: Rotschwert V1.1 - Out Now
notes.content:
Rotschwert's Steam release, as well as the V1.1 update, are now out. You may purchase, download and play the game now. Thank you for your patience!

A proper announcement and changelog will be posted after a proper nap. For now - please enjoy my weird little bunny game ːHelen_wink2ː

- Aru

(P.S. - Japanese translation is still WIP and is currently disabled. A separate build will be released as a beta branch within a few days)

notes.title: Rotschwert Demo has been Released
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3459120/Rotschwert_Demo/

It is a short demo for an already rather small-scoped game. I hope you enjoy, and for those who already bought Rotschwert on itchio - this may serve as an early glimpse of the upcoming update.

New visual elements have been added, and current ones have been mildly adjusted. Enemy attacks are slightly more varied with more bullet types. Performance and framerate have improved considerably - it should be very noticeable on lower-end machines. And as for new content - as ever, you might catch a little glimpse of... Something More (but only a little, really. Not pulling your leg here.)

I have also added a Japanese translation, though I cannot guarantee its quality at this time. If your system language is Japanese, the game will switch to it automatically. Any feedback and corrections will be appreciated.

Have fun, don't dive too deep \o/
